Description: Parcel Identification Number (PIN) / Assessor's Parcel Number (APN)

Mailing Address second line, often Suite number, Building number, or other mailing information
Mailing Address third line, often City, State, and Zip
Building / Home area in square feet
Derived Land Use Class ('Residential', 'Agricultural', 'Commercial', 'Tax Exempt', 'Industrial', or 'Mineral')
Acreage calculated from area of geometry
Latitude of a point within the parcel
Longitude of a point within the parcel
Calculated acreage of this and nearby parcels having the same owner
Property record identifier likely to remain consistent across updates, particularly if a property's parcel_id is unchanged and distinct within its county.
